subject: Re: Northfield site visit — prospect vacation week, propose split recording + live Q&A
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Laura Stevens <laura.stevens@northfieldhealth.org>, Tom Herrera <therrera@northfieldhealth.org>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Northfield site visit — proposed onsite week of Jan 18 (agenda attached)

Hi Laura / Tom —

Great to lock in planning for the on-site technical walkthrough. Per our last call, we were looking at the week of Jan 18 for an on-site day to run system walkthroughs, integration planning, and a clinician-focused demo.

Proposed:
- Date: Tuesday, Jan 18
- Time: 10:00 AM — 2:00 PM ET
- Location: Northfield HQ (main conference room)

I've attached a draft agenda (Northfield_Roadshow_Agenda.pdf) and a short feature checklist so we can tailor the deep-dive. If that date works we will bring a recording kit and provide a 20–30 minute condensed version for any stakeholders who can't attend in person.

If anything in the agenda should change before I finalize travel, call that out and we will update.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Northfield_Roadshow_Agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Dr. Laura Stevens <laura.stevens@northfieldhealth.org>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Herrera <therrera@northfieldhealth.org>
Date: Mon, 4 Jan 2027 13:06:11 -0500
Subject: Re: Northfield site visit — proposed onsite week of Jan 18 (agenda attached)

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the draft agenda — it looks thorough. Quick complication on our side: our clinical lead, Dr. Patel (who needs to see the clinician demo), is out on a previously scheduled vacation the week of Jan 18 (Jan 18–22). That week also coincides with a regional field event where a number of our product owners will be traveling.

Options from our side:
1) Move the on-site to the week of Jan 25 (we can do Jan 26 or 27) so all decision-makers can be present for the full session; or
2) Keep Jan 18 but split the engagement: you record the deep-dive (detailed demo + integration Q&A) ahead of time and then do a 45-minute live Q&A (virtual) with the extended team the week of Jan 18; or
3) Convert the clinical portion to an asynchronous review (recording + written notes) and run a shortened 90-minute on-site focused on ops/integration.

We're leaning toward option 2 (split: recorded deep-dive + live Q&A) because we want to keep some on-site presence for infrastructure walkthroughs but accommodate Dr. Patel's vacation. If we go that route, can you deliver the recording by Friday, Jan 15 so Dr. Patel can watch before the live Q&A?

Also: we'll need the finalized slide deck and a short list of technical pre-reqs for our IT team before you travel.

Appreciate the flexibility — let me know what works for you.

Best,
Laura
Director of Clinical Programs | Northfield Health
laura.stevens@northfieldhealth.org
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Laura Stevens <laura.stevens@northfieldhealth.org>, Tom Herrera <therrera@northfieldhealth.org>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Northfield site visit — split recording + live Q&A option (options & ask)

Laura / Tom —

Thanks — option 2 works well for us and is something we do often to avoid extra travel while keeping stakeholders aligned. Two quick asks so we can lock logistics:

1) Which of these three execution approaches do you prefer?
   A) Keep on-site Jan 18 for ops/integration; we record the clinician deep-dive ahead of time and deliver by Jan 15. Live Q&A (virtual) during Jan 18 for clinicians who saw the recording.
   B) Move the full on-site to Jan 26/27 (no change to format).
   C) Short on-site (90 min) on Jan 18 + recording for clinical deep-dive.

2) If you pick A or C, we will need confirmed list of clinicians who must see the recording and any integration owners so we can tailor the recording checklist.

Operational note for you: recording turn-around to final MP4 + time-stamped index is typically 48–72 hours after the live capture. If you need the file by Jan 15 we should record the week of Jan 11–14 and finalize by end of day Jan 15.

Marcus / Hannah — can one of you handle the on-site ops if Northfield keeps Jan 18? Hannah can run the recording kit remotely; Marcus, could you cover the in-person integration walk if we keep Jan 18? If not, we should move the on-site to Jan 26/27 to avoid extra travel.

I'll await Laura's confirmation and the list of required attendees.

Thanks,
Irene
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 09:02:23 -0800
Subject: Internal: Northfield — coverage check for Jan 18 vs move to Jan 26/27

Team — quick internal note (short thread so CRM has a copy):

Laura prefers the split (recording + live Q&A). Their ask: recording in hand by Jan 15; live virtual Q&A the week of Jan 18. They still want some on-site presence for infrastructure walkthroughs, but it's flexible on exact timing.

Options to avoid double travel:
- If Marcus can travel to Northfield on Jan 18 and Hannah can manage capture/oversight (Hannah remote or local depending on flight), we keep Jan 18.
- If Marcus cannot, move on-site to Jan 26/27 and consolidate travel.

Marcus — can you confirm availability for Jan 18 by EOD so I can confirm with Laura? If not, we'll propose Jan 26/27.

Also: budget note — if we add a separate Jan 26 trip we should confirm whether Northfield will cover travel for a second onsite and whether we can combine with the regional field event nearby (cost savings). I'll add that to the HubSpot note.

Thanks,
Irene
From: Tom Herrera <therrera@northfieldhealth.org>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Laura Stevens <laura.stevens@northfieldhealth.org>
Date: Wed, 6 Jan 2027 15:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Northfield site visit — split recording + live Q&A option (confirming approach)

Hi Irene —

We'd like to proceed with approach A from your options: keep the on-site for Jan 18 for ops/integration, have Redwood record the clinician deep-dive in the week prior, and deliver the final MP4 + index by Friday Jan 15. We'll schedule a live virtual Q&A for Jan 19 at 09:30–10:15 ET for clinicians who view the recording; Dr. Patel will watch the recording in advance.

Action items we need from Redwood:
- Final slide deck and technical pre-reqs for IT by Jan 8 end of day
- Recording capture (MP4 + time-stamped index) delivered by Jan 15
- On-site integration checklist for our infrastructure team (short list)

I'll upload the attendee list to the HubSpot record and flag travel approval for your team if you confirm Jan 18.

Thanks — Tom

Attachments referenced: Requested_Feature_List.xlsx
